article_notes: 30 dogs with acute babesiosis and shock (university clinic, Ukraine) vs 30 healthy dogs: haemodynamic and haemorheological parameters compared only with controls (Tables 1-3), then two plasma-substitute treatment groups (Rheopolyglucin vs Rheosorbylact) compared over 72 h (figures only). Treatment groups are not severity groups and no outcome was compared. Nothing against severity to extract. English translation used (LLM translation, not reviewed).
